roots.title: Constraint and Logic-Based Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Constraint and Logic-Based Optimization; formal statements are stored in a later sidecar layer.

children.title: Finite-Domain Constraint Models
children.top_down_role: Finite-domain constraint satisfaction and optimization as modeling, structural, computational, and language-based frameworks; Boolean proof systems, SMT theory solving, and integer-optimization machinery remain cross-part dependencies.

children.title: Global-Constraint Template Families
children.top_down_role: Global finite-domain constraint families, their specialized reasoning architectures, scheduling and configuration templates, computational interfaces, and characteristic failure boundaries; general CSP search and mathematical-programming theory remain cross-linked.

children.title: Consistency-Propagation Theory
children.top_down_role: Local consistency, filtering, propagation semantics, propagation algorithms, global-constraint filtering, solver-kernel mechanisms, complexity boundaries, and failure regimes; search, modeling, SAT, and mathematical-programming methods appear only at their interfaces.

children.title: Propagation-Guided CP Search Family
children.top_down_role: Systematic and heuristic search over propagated constraint models, including branching, backtracking, learning, restarts, constraint optimization, and large-neighborhood improvement; propagation algorithms, global-constraint filtering, SAT theory, solver infrastructure, and general metaheuristic theory remain external dependencies.

children.title: SAT Representation-to-Certification Stack
children.top_down_role: Propositional satisfiability from Boolean representation and reduction through practical solving, structural complexity, proof production, and independently checkable certification. MaxSAT, model counting, QBF, SMT, constraint programming, and application-specific verification remain neighboring chapters or Parts.

children.title: Boolean Optimization Representation Family
children.top_down_role: Boolean optimization through soft-clause and pseudo-Boolean representations, exact and approximate solution paradigms, correctness principles, certificates, implementation regimes, and application templates.

children.title: SMT-OMT Solver Hierarchy
children.top_down_role: Logical fragments, background theories, SMT architectures, modular theory combination, optimization extensions, correctness families, certificates, complexity boundaries, and operational interfaces.

children.title: CP-SAT Solver Architecture
children.top_down_role: Architecture and correctness interfaces of integer-based CP-SAT solvers; general CP, SAT, scheduling, and integer-programming theory remain external dependencies.

children.title: Constraint Integer Programming Hybrid Architectures
children.top_down_role: Integrated uses of constraint-programming inference and mixed-integer optimization relaxations, including single-tree constraint integer programming, logic-based decomposition, and cooperating-solver architectures.

children.title: Logic-Based Benders Decomposition
children.top_down_role: Structural navigation for decomposition driven by inference certificates, including decision-diagram subproblem interfaces and hybrid optimization regimes.

children.title: Decision-Diagram Optimization
children.top_down_role: Layered decision-diagram representations and their use as exact models, bounded approximations, search engines, propagation structures, and solver components for discrete optimization.

children.title: Distributed Constraint Optimization
children.top_down_role: Discrete distributed constraint satisfaction and optimization for cooperative multi-agent coordination, including canonical extensions, structural decompositions, resolution families, certificates, communication, privacy, and operational boundaries.

children.title: Constraint-Based Plan-Schedule-Configuration Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Constraint-centered models and reasoning architectures for constructing, scheduling, configuring, validating, explaining, and repairing discrete plans and products; generic solver internals and general integer-optimization theory remain cross-linked.
